tools.description: Not implemented. The daemon has no add-member route, so this returns {"error":"not_implemented"} and does not call the daemon.

member.description: Member fragment. The tool returns `not_implemented` and does not post it.

podNamespace.description: Pod namespace, percent-encoded into the path.

rigId.description: Rig id, percent-encoded into the path.

tools.name: agent_add

tools.description: List seats for rigId. Resolves the id or name with GET /api/rigs/summary, then returns that rig's seats from GET /api/seats.

rigId.description: Rig id or name. Resolved through `GET /api/rigs/summary`, then filtered in `GET /api/seats`.

tools.name: agent_list

tools.description: Read one seat's live screen through POST /api/seats/capture. rig and pod are refused.

lines.description: Capture line budget. Omitted uses the daemon default.

pod.description: Refused. The daemon captures one seat, not a pod.

rig.description: Refused. The daemon captures one seat, not every seat in a rig.

session.description: Seat or session name. Required unless `rig` or `pod` is set, and those are refused.

tools.name: agent_read_screen

tools.description: Deliver text to a seat through POST /api/send. The sender is the seat-token headers, not a body from field. A replaced pane is refused before paste. force does not set dangerously_interact. force combined with waitForIdleSeconds is rejected before any request. A positive waitForIdleSeconds is refused and does not extend the timeout.

force.description: Accepted only so `force` plus `waitForIdleSeconds` can be rejected locally.

verify.description: Ask the daemon to verify delivery.

waitForIdleSeconds.description: Refused when set. The send route has no idle wait, so the timeout is not extended.

tools.name: agent_send

tools.description: Resolve rigName via GET /api/rigs/summary, then GET /api/rigs/{id}/chat/history?limit=20. Two daemon calls. This is history, not a stream.
tools.name: chat_read

tools.description: Resolve rigName via GET /api/rigs/summary, then POST /api/rigs/{id}/chat/send. Optional sender is accepted and not forwarded. Seat headers are forwarded when this process is a seat.

sender.description: Accepted and not forwarded. The daemon derives the sender.

tools.name: chat_send

tools.description: GET /healthz and return that body. It has status and pid, and no version field. When the socket is down, returns {"running": false} and does not start the daemon.
tools.name: daemon_health

tools.description: Post the YAML file at sourceRef to POST /api/rigs/up. plan, autoApprove, and targetRoot are refused when set to change bring-up. A file that is not a rig spec is rejected without quoting its contents.

autoApprove.description: `true` is refused. The daemon bring-up has no auto-approve flag.

plan.description: `true` is refused. The daemon bring-up has no plan-only mode.

sourceRef.description: Path to a rig spec YAML file.

targetRoot.description: Any value is refused. The daemon bring-up has no target root.

tools.name: rig_start

tools.description: Stop one rig via POST /api/rigs/down with {"rig": rigId}. snapshot true creates a snapshot first and does not stop if that fails. delete and force are refused.

delete.description: `true` is refused. The daemon `down` route does not delete the rig record.

rigId.description: Rig id or name the daemon `down` route understands.

snapshot.description: `true` creates a snapshot, then stops. A failed snapshot does not stop the rig.

tools.name: rig_stop

tools.description: Create a snapshot via POST /api/snapshot/create with {"rig": rigId}.
tools.name: snapshot_create

tools.description: List snapshots via POST /api/snapshot/list with {"rig": rigId}.
tools.name: snapshot_list

tools.description: Restore via POST /api/restore with {"rig": rigId, "snapshot": snapshotId}.
tools.name: snapshot_restore

tools.description: Check that agent YAML is a mapping with a non-empty name. This is not a full AgentSpec schema. No daemon call. Result is {valid, errors}.
tools.name: spec_validate_agent

tools.description: Validate RigSpec YAML locally with crewmux-spec. No daemon call. Result is {valid, errors}.
tools.name: spec_validate_rig
